newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine 500 mln peso Eurobond priced at 99.423.
newsitem.headline: Argentine 500 mln peso Eurobond priced at 99.423.

text.p: Argentina priced Wednesday a 500 million 10-year peso-denominated Eurobond at 99.423, and said the issue showed investors' confidence in the country.
The Economy Ministry said in a statement the bond, which matures on Feb 12, 2007, carries a coupon of 11.75 percent. The bond will be listed in Buenos Aires and Luxembourg.
"The issue is the first one in pesos with a maturity of 10 years and reflects the confidence in the financial community in Argentina and the economic reforms it has implemented," said the ministry.
The last international peso issue was a 2-year 250 million bond with a coupon of 8.75 percent.
